HTTP/2 stream state machine and state transition helpers.

# Purpose
`fd_h2_stream.h` defines the HTTP/2 stream state machine used by the connection code. It declares `fd_h2_stream_t`, which stores the stream ID, transmit and receive window values, the stream state, and a header sequence counter, and it defines the stream states `IDLE`, `OPEN`, `CLOSING_TX`, `CLOSING_RX`, `CLOSED`, and `ILLEGAL`. The file also provides inline helpers to initialize a stream, open it, handle close and reset transitions, process received `HEADERS` and `DATA` frame flags, and update the active stream count in `fd_h2_conn_t`. One non-inline function, [`fd_h2_rst_stream`](<#fd_h2_rst_stream>), is declared for generating a `RST_STREAM` frame and closing the stream.
